track.purpose: Empty part of every bar: foreground at 10 % alpha (computed).

blocked.purpose: Bar fill from 90 % and at the limit.

blocked-text.purpose: Critical numbers, At limit, errors: blocked mixed 22 % toward foreground (computed).

accent.purpose: Sign in again, switch on, focused field border.

border.purpose: Section rules in the detail view.

hover.purpose: Hover ground over rows and controls.

dialog-title.purpose: Connect dialog title and Remove's question.

window-line.purpose: Window lines in the detail view.

numbers.purpose: Percentages, resets, status words and the list's hint.

shadows.name: menu

components.name: Account Row with Pair of Bars
components.description: One account in the list: mark and label, weekly bar over the thin 5-hour bar 6 px apart, each with its pace tick centred on it, one quiet line of numbers; two bars at most, a reached per-model limit said in words in the critical text colour in place of the week's reset time ("41% · Fable at limit"); a click opens the account view.

components.name: Hint
components.description: The band on the list's bottom edge whenever accounts are cut off below: 34 px, its top 8 px fading from clear to chrome, with "3 more" in muted and Herdr's 11 px chevron-down in dim, centred 11 px above the edge. Not a control; it goes when the last account is in view. In the rail a 16 px band with "+3" at 10.5 px.

components.name: Limit Dot
components.description: A reached per-model limit in the rail and the strip: a 5 px blocked dot, ringed 1.5 px in the ground colour, on the mark's upper right corner, 2 px above its box and 3 px beyond it. It takes no room; the tooltip ends with the words. Never in the list, where the words are.

components.description: "Limits" over the list with one quiet control that opens the detail view.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Remove's Dialog with Danger Button

narrative.overview:
Headroom is a gauge that lives inside someone else's dashboard. It has no world of its own: every colour but one is a named colour of the running Herdr theme, read from `theme()` at render, and the type is Herdr's UI font (Geist) with its terminal font (JetBrains Mono) for codes and addresses. The one fixed colour is Claude's orange, on Claude's spark. What it owns is a structure, the pair of bars, and a temperament: Claude-like restraint, few symbols, states written as words, shapes drawn rather than typed as terminal glyphs.

The surface is glanced at between other work, in the left sidebar beside Herdr's Spaces and Agents mods. It is dense and calm. Nothing carries colour until something is wrong: at rest every fill and number is `muted`, and the theme's `working` and `blocked` appear only when a window passes 75 % and 90 %. The bar always keeps its full width; the numbers sit in one quiet 11 px line beneath it and never take the bar's room.

The values in the frontmatter are the graphite theme (Herdr's default dark). They are a reference, not constants: the code names the role (`t.chrome`, `t.muted`) and paper, ink, moss and atom-one-dark supply their own values for the same names.
keyCharacteristics: Thickness names the window: a full 6 px bar for a weekly window, a 3 px bar for the 5-hour one, 6 px apart. Two bars at most on a row; a reached per-model limit is said in words, or as a dot on the mark where there is no room for words.
Colour only for trouble; a level is always paired with its number or the words "At limit".
A 2 px pace tick centred on its bar, reaching 2 px above and below it, with a ground-coloured halo, says whether an account is burning faster than its window.

The providers' own logos: the ChatGPT logo in `foreground`, Claude's spark in Claude's orange (`#D97757`), the one colour not taken from the theme. Herdr's own spinner, icons, scrollbar and toasts, and the layout of its dialogs; no brand, logo or palette of the mod's own.
Native motion only: fills and ticks slide with `.transition`, waits spin with `.spin(900)`.

rules.name: The Colour Is Trouble Rule
rules.body: At rest, everything is `muted` or `foreground`. `working` and `blocked` appear only when a window is high, critical or at its limit, and `accent` only on what can be clicked to fix something.

rules.name: The Never By Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A level is always beside its number; at 100 % the number becomes the words "At limit". Nothing is told by hue only.

rules.name: The Theme Owns The Values Rule
rules.body: Never write a hex value in the mod, with one exception: Claude's orange (`#D97757`) on Claude's spark. Name the theme role; derive anything else (track, level numbers, badge tint) from theme roles with `mix()` and `alpha()`.

rules.name: The Words Not Glyphs Rule
rules.body: States are written: "At limit", "Sign in again", "not started", "12m old · network". No warning triangles, no terminal block characters. The only typed symbol is the "·" separator in `dim`, and the compact "!" badge copied from Herdr.

rules.name: The Quiet Number Rule
rules.body: Percentages and countdowns are 11 px and `muted` under the bar; they never get a column of their own beside it. Format: "41% · 4d 6h"; alone on a row, "23% · resets in 5d 2h".

rules.name: The No Card Rule
rules.body: No borders, pills or containers around an account. The pair of bars and the 9 px gap are the grouping.

dos: **Do** name theme roles (`t.chrome`, `t.muted`) and derive the rest with `mix()` and `alpha()`; the mod follows every Herdr theme, light and dark.

**Do** keep the weekly bar full (6 px) and the 5-hour bar thin (3 px), 6 px apart (4 px in the rail and the strip), at the full width, in every form, and centre each pace tick on its bar, 2 px above and below (1 px in the rail and the strip).
**Do** put the percentage and reset under the bar in 11 px `muted`, with the level colour only on the percentage.
**Do** mix level colours 22 % toward `foreground` for text, so every readable number holds 4.5:1 on graphite and paper.
**Do** draw only the windows a plan reports; a weekly-only account has one bar.
**Do** draw each account with its provider's own logo, from the mod's own `mods/headroom/icons/`: the ChatGPT logo (`chatgpt.svg`) in `foreground`, Claude's spark (`claude.svg`) in Claude's orange.
**Do** reuse Herdr's assets: spinner, plus and chevron icons, scrollbar, toasts, and the layout of its dialogs.
**Do** move a bar to a new reading with `.transition`; nothing pulses or redraws on a timer for motion.
donts: **Don't** write a hex value in the mod other than Claude's orange on its spark, or give it a logo, brand colour or palette of its own.
**Don't** tell a level by colour alone, or colour anything at rest.
**Don't** give the numbers a column beside the bar, or shorten the bar to fit them.
**Don't** wrap accounts in cards, borders or pills, or sort them by usage.
**Don't** use terminal glyphs, block characters or warning symbols; write the state as words.
**Don't** use `dim` for anything a person must read beyond where Herdr's own mods use it.
**Don't** add a collapse control to the list, or a grouping setting.
**Don't** draw a third bar on a row, or the dot of a reached limit in the list.
